summary_1line: Vyasa explains the renunciate (Sannyasa) path: solitary yoga, non‑violence, detachment, humility, and inner sacrifice leading to emancipation beyond death.

image_candidates.scene_text: A solitary ascetic in ragged robes sits beneath a tree with a human skull-bowl, meditating in silence while a quiet village lies in the distance.
A serene mendicant stands unmoved while people around him praise and insult him, his face calm and detached amid the crowd.
An ascetic performs an inner sacrifice, imagined flames glowing in his heart as he offers his senses and mind into the inner fire.
